rules.label: In a library or facing a Librarian (Bookworm: ↓1)

any: ask:in a library or facing a Librarian

automation.notes: Automatic: when the scene's name includes "library" or your target is a Librarian, every Skill Test (Initiative too) takes ↓1, labelled Bookworm in the Roll Options Dialog. Roll Options Dialog: otherwise, a Bookworm switch adds the ↓1 for other library situations.

source.book: Welcome to Night Vale: Citizens' Guide
